{{Top|leg}}
The '''"DeathWhispers"''' were a unit of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] assigned around 20 [[ZQ Infantry Support Unit|ZQ infantry droids]], which they were outfitting to serve their needs. They were tasked with [[Pacification of Hyrol Preen Beta|wiping out]] the populace of [[Hyrol Preen Beta]] due to suspected [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
